summary: A company developing a hot polymer extrusion process incorporating an active pharmaceutical ingredient wants to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt during processing. They have offline assays, note the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up, and request an initial comparison plan plus the questions required before choosing a probe.
